title: feat(types)!: an authored object-map takes its props in the spec's properties bag; the flat spelling is refused by name (objectui#10859, batch 5)
body:
Part of #10859
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, copied from the PM claim `5922517136`: `@object-ui/types`' authoring faces widen (a spec-shaped `object-map` bag node that is refused today parses) and narrow (a flat `object-map` node that parses today is refused). This is objectui's narrowing-as-`minor` rule with a **BREAKING (authoring)** banner in the changeset, as in batches 1 to 4.

Batch 5 of objectui#10859. It executes seat 1's flat-arm answer at PR objectui#11248's ACCEPT (`5917261346`, A by inheritance from triage's A on objectui#10872, `5906817482`) for ONE block, `object-map`, following batch 4 (PR objectui#11291, `e3782d26ec`). The card stays open for `object-gantt`, the designer six and the (ii) / (iii) keys.

## What changed

- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`: new `ObjectMapBlockSchema`, batch 4's construct. It is `BaseSchema` + the `object-map` literal + `NODE_ENVELOPE` + `properties = propsBag('object-map', stripImportedDefaults(SpecObjectMapPropsSchema))`: the shared helpers and the installed 17.5.0 row by reference, no copy, no new props helper. Beside it:
  - `dataSource`, the spec's `ElementDataSourceSchema` by reference (the registration is `elementDataSourceBlock`-wrapped);
  - one `aliasKeyRefusal` per member of the row, keyed by the row's own key set read off the crossed row, so each prop written flat is refused on both faces with `Did you mean KEY → properties.KEY?` and one prescription that shows the whole bag document;
  - two more by-name refusals for the flat mirror's compatibility members `locationField` / `titleField`, pointed at `properties.map.KEY` (their bag home is the row's `map` block; the row refuses them at the bag's top level);
  - `body` / `children` refused with the flat mirror's objectui#9256 string;
  - the record-source rule, read in the bag (see the open question below).
- The arm joins `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema`. `ObjectMapSchema` (the flat mirror) leaves `ObjectQLComponentSchema` (11 to 10 arms), stays exported, and stays paired with its TypeScript twin in the parity census.
- `requireRecordSource` gains an `at` parameter. The default (`'node'`) is unchanged for the three flat mirrors; `'properties'` reads the three rungs inside the bag and also counts the node's `dataSource` binding, whose `object` `ElementDataSourceGate` lands on `objectName`.
- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: the TypeScript `ObjectMapSchema` is **re-declared, not retired**. Its members are unchanged; its docblock says it is the node as `ObjectMap` reads it after `SchemaRenderer` hoists `properties`, and as code composes it. The TypeScript union's docblock names the zod union's new count.
- `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts` (one barrel export) and `packages/types/src/zod/README.md` (the ObjectQL public-block group lists the arm, 5).
- `packages/plugin-map/src/index.tsx`: the registration's `objectName` input description now names the node's `dataSource` binding beside the three rungs, since the authored arm counts it; the comment above the registration says where the rule lives now.
- objectui's authored flat producers, rewritten to the bag (census below): `content/docs/plugins/plugin-map.mdx`, `content/docs/fields/location.mdx`, the three `examples/schema-catalog` map entries, `packages/plugin-map/README.md` (2 of its 3 nodes), and the `objectui check` output example in `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx`.
- New pins: `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-map-properties-bag-10859-b5.test.ts` (both faces, the row by reference, the record source, the split) and `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.propertiesBag-10859.test.tsx` (render through the real registry).
- Two changesets: `.changeset/10859-object-map-properties-bag.md` (`@object-ui/types` minor, BREAKING (authoring) banner) and `.changeset/10859-plugin-map-properties-bag-docs.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-map` patch: README examples and the `objectName` input description).

**Files beyond the claimed surface**, each forced:
- census rows the new export forces: `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (one `EXCLUSIONS` row; `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` untouched), `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts` (one `IMPORTED` row), `registered-type-arms-10859-b2.test.ts` (the exact literal list gains `object-map`), `objectql-union-arms-7363.test.ts` (10 arms, and `object-map` is not among them), `public-block-responsive-styles-10872.test.ts` (`object-map` joins `DECLARES_DATA_SOURCE`; its only-`responsiveStyles` row gives `object-map` the smallest record source, because the arm keeps the rule);
- fixture triage where a face now judges the bag (the mirror rows keep the post-hoist spelling): `content-channel-e3-residual-9256.test.ts`, `object-map-config-strict-5157.test.ts`, `objectql-record-source-refinement-6939.test.ts`, `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts`, plugin-map's `ObjectMap.catalogRecordSource-6939.test.tsx` (reads the bag entries; its render-identity readings are unchanged), `index.recordSourceInput-7470.test.tsx` (the description names `dataSource`), `index.bareMapKeyRetired-10393.test.tsx` (its zod-face control uses the bag; the html tier keeps attribute keys);
- two files held by draft PR objectui#11069, see Deviations: `packages/cli/src/__tests__/check-first-issue-11007.test.ts` (its flat `object-map` fixtures went red) and `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx` (its `check` output example became false).

## Zone 1, measured before building

1. **The inherited reason holds for this arm.** Installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0: `ComponentPropsMap['object-map']` exists and is the exported `ObjectMapPropsSchema` (members `objectName`, `data`, `staticData`, `filter`, `sort`, `map`, `mapStyle`, `navigation`, `enableClustering`; strict). `PageComponentSchema` refuses `{ type: 'object-map', objectName, latitudeField, longitudeField }` with `unrecognized_keys` ("Unrecognized key(s) on this page component … ADR-0089 D3a") and accepts the same props in `properties`. Control: a flat `action:button` `actionType` is refused the same way.
2. **Census, with objectui#11276's stop line.** At base `d79f525d9`, 78 non-test files name `object-map`: 18 `CHANGELOG.md` and 25 pending changesets (records, not producers) and 35 others:

| class | files | action |
|:--|:--|:--|
| authored page-node producers | `plugin-map.mdx` (14 nodes and the Schema API block), `location.mdx` (1), the 3 schema-catalog map entries, `packages/plugin-map/README.md` (2 nodes), `cli.mdx` (an output example) | rewritten |
| component mount (post-hoist `schema` prop, no hoist) | `packages/plugin-map/README.md` "Using `ObjectMap` directly" | kept flat, now said so (measured: a bag handed straight to `ObjectMap` draws the "Map configuration required" refusal and fetches nothing) |
| runtime composers | `ListView.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx` (flatten a stored map view) | kept flat; they render through `SchemaRenderer` and never meet the zod faces |
| the declarations | `objectql.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts` | this change |
| names the type, no node shape | registration and registry (`register-plugins.ts`, `plugin-map/src/index.tsx`, `ObjectMap.tsx`, `Registry.ts`, `public-blocks.ts`, `record-source.ts`, `known-schema-types.ts`), comments and ledgers (`ValueDataSource.ts`, `ElementDataSourceGate.tsx`, `react-page.tsx`, `plugin-tree/src/index.tsx`, `check.ts`, `registerCatalogBlocks.ts`, `vite.config.ts`, `vite-types-zod-lazy.ts`, four `scripts/check-*` / ledger scripts), prose (`component.prompt.md`, `data-source.md`, `ci-cd-pipeline.md`, `packages/types/README.md`), and `FlowKeyValueField.tsx` (a key/value "object map", unrelated) | none |
| governed `skills/**` | none (`git grep object-map -- skills/` at base: 0 files; control `object-form`: 2 files) | none to list |

   **Stop line: not tripped.** No objectui context builds anything from the zod `ObjectMapSchema` object: its only reader was the `ObjectQLComponentSchema` union (unlike `object-view`'s `form` slot, built from `ObjectFormSchema`). The non-page contexts that keep the flat spelling depend on the TypeScript twin (composers, the component's `schema` prop) or on the registration's `inputs` (the sdui-parser html tier, whose attributes are the node's own keys), not on that object.
3. **The arm**, as above. `ObjectMapSchema` is re-declared, not retired.
4. **Producers**: rewritten as above; zero governed producers.
5. **Pins**: below. The objectui#10859 ratchet does not move: `object-map` was never refused at `type`.

## Zone 2, re-measured

1. Held: `ObjectMapSchema` is in `objectql.zod.ts`, its TypeScript twin in `objectql.ts`, and batch 4's `ObjectFormBlockSchema` sits before the public-block union, where the new arm follows it.
2. Not held as a count: 78 non-test files name `object-map` (35 outside the CHANGELOG and changeset records), not about 6; the producers among them are the seven files rewritten above.
3. PR objectui#11292 merged as `d79f525d9` before this branch's first edit; the branch was fast-forwarded to it, so this diff is anchored there. Since then `main` moved by `1ccb5ba7d` (layout and i18n only): `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` exits 0.

## Open question for the seat: the record-source rule on the bag arm

The spec row keeps `objectName`, `data` and `staticData` all optional and has no "one of them" rule, so `{ type: 'object-map' }` passes the spec's own page component. This arm keeps the flat mirror's rule (`77cb489b4`, the maintainer ruling recorded 2026-09-02), read in the bag and counting `dataSource`, so a sourceless authored map is refused here. Options:
- **K (implemented):** keep the rule on the authored arm. It retires no ruling, keeps the registration's "the `object-map` schema refuses a block that declares none of them" true, and refuses a document that draws an empty map with no diagnostic. Cost: objectui is narrower than the spec on a document no producer writes, and the extended helper is local.
- **D:** follow the row exactly, as batch 4 left `object-form`'s optional `objectName` optional: drop the rule from the arm, retire the registration's refusal sentence, and take the rule upstream to the spec's row if it is wanted. Cost: a sourceless map validates green and renders nothing.
- Recommendation: K now, on the four axes. Business: no producer writes a sourceless map, so the two options differ only on an authoring error. Long-term: the rule's right home is the spec row, and D is the end state once objectstack carries it; a dev batch does not retire a maintainer ruling on the way. AI-proofing: K refuses loudly what D accepts silently. Startup scope: neither adds surface or a gate.

## Deviations

- **Two files held by draft PR objectui#11069 edited, both forced.** `check-first-issue-11007.test.ts` asserts verdicts on flat `object-map` fixtures, which this change refuses, so its fixtures now write the bag and its expected paths read `properties.map`. `cli.mdx`'s `objectui check` example printed `Issue at map: …`, which no `object-map` document produces any more; it now prints the measured `Issue at properties → map: …` line. Both hunks are outside that PR's: `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` with its head `a11f73347` conflicts only in `packages/cli/src/commands/check.ts`, which this branch does not touch and which conflicts identically between base `d79f525d9` and that PR.
- **`requireRecordSource` gained an `at` parameter** rather than staying out of this batch: the record-source rule could not be read in the bag otherwise. The flat mirrors' default is unchanged. The open question above is what the seat may want instead.
- **`locationField` / `titleField` are refused by name on the bag arm**, beyond batch 4's row-key-only refusal set: they were declared members of the flat mirror and their bag home is `properties.map`. The flat `map`-config spellings the mirror never declared (`latitudeField`, …) keep their verdict: unjudged by the tolerant face, refused by the strict one.
- **A bag bound only through `dataSource` now validates.** The flat arm refused it although it renders (the gate supplies `objectName`); the bag arm counts the binding.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-map` source change and a second changeset**: the registration's `objectName` description names the binding.
- Zone 2 item 2's count did not hold (above).
- The harness attribution reminder asked for model-named commit trailers and a different PR footer. Per AGENTS.md and the role file, the commits carry the model-free pair and this body the session-URL footer.

## Acceptance notes

- **The bag follows the spec row, which is not the flat mirror.** Measured in the b5 pin: the `map` block is the row's own `map` member (the same eight keys, closed; a typo reads `Unrecognized key(s) on this map configuration … Did you mean …`); a `map`-config key written in the bag beside it is refused with the spec's prescription to move it into `map`; `filter` takes the rule-array form only (the flat mirror took any array); `properties.filters` gets the spec's alias refusal; `navigation` is `z.unknown()` in the row, so its members are not judged inside the bag (the flat mirror judged them through `NavigationConfigSchema`).
- **The sdui-parser html tier spells this node flat by design**: its attributes are the node's keys, checked against the registration's `inputs`, and a `properties` attribute draws its `unknown-prop` warning. The same holds for every batch-2 to batch-4 arm; nothing writes a `properties` attribute today.
- **`object-gantt`'s flat arm** has the same `dataSource`-only refusal the flat map arm had; batch 6 meets it with the arm.
- No governed producer names `object-map`, so nothing goes to the governed path from this batch.
